viewing_check: Armitage estimate 60-90, current bid $20 (+22% premium). About 19 books: the plain cloth early copies (Baltic, Hunts Big Game, Delivers the Goods, Air Commodore) have no jackets and the later 1950s-60s Hodder copies have pictorial jackets (some chipped). Check copyright pages for 'First published' dates and 1st-edition status, the Baltic thick vs thin binding, jacket condition, and library stamps or label damage. Bulk Biggles lots on eBay AU run about A$4-5 a book (12 books A$62, 9 books A$48, 44 books A$208) and ordinary single copies A$9-34; only genuine firsts in dust jackets reach A$75-135. Expect about A$70-130 for this lot. Prices 2023-2026, flat.
